question: Customers decided for themselves whether to join the loyalty programme, and the keen shoppers are the ones who join and also spend more. We have no measure of how keen they are. Did joining the programme increase annual spend?

We want to claim the loyalty programme raises spending. Membership was opt-in and we suspect an unobserved 'shopping enthusiasm' drives both membership and spend. No experiment, no instrument. What method?
joined_loyalty vs annual_spend: members spend more, but people self-select based on how much they like shopping with us, which isn't in the data. Can we get the causal effect?
Is the extra spend of loyalty members caused by the programme? Caveat: brand affinity, which we never measured, makes people both sign up and buy more.
My boss wants the causal effect of the loyalty program on annual_spend. Sign-up was voluntary and there's a hidden confounder (customer engagement) we can't observe. How do I estimate it?
Клиенты сами решали, вступать ли в программу лояльности, а их увлечённость покупками, которую мы не измеряем, влияет и на вступление, и на траты. Увеличила ли программа годовые траты?
Программа лояльности добровольная, есть скрытый конфаундер — интерес к нашему магазину, его в данных нет. Как оценить эффект joined_loyalty на annual_spend?
Observational data only: loyalty members opted in. Some unmeasured trait affects both joining and spending. What's the effect of joining on spend?

Users turned push notifications on themselves, and their general engagement, which we don't record, drives both that choice and retention. What would you use to measure the effect of got_push on retention?
Did receiving pushes keep users around longer? Heads-up: whoever opts into pushes is probably more engaged to begin with, and engagement isn't in the table.
Need a causal estimate: got_push -> retention. The push flag was self-selected and an unobserved confounder affects both.
Хотим понять, повышают ли пуши удержание. Пуши включали сами пользователи, а их активность, которой нет в данных, влияет и на это, и на retention. Что делать?
We rolled out self-checkout in all 25 stores in January 2023. Did it increase revenue?
Every store got self-checkout at the same time. What's the effect of self_checkout on monthly revenue?
Revenue went up after self-checkout launched chain-wide. How do I estimate the causal impact? There's no store without it.
Кассы самообслуживания поставили сразу во все магазины в один месяц. Выросла ли от этого выручка?
Can I use difference-in-differences to measure what self-checkout did to revenue? All stores switched at once.
All 14 clinics introduced digital triage in July 2023. Did waiting times go down because of it?
digital_triage was switched on everywhere on the same date. What's the causal effect on avg_wait_minutes?
Wait times fell after we launched digital triage across the network. Was it the triage? We have no clinic that kept the old process.
Цифровую сортировку пациентов запустили во всех клиниках одновременно. Как оценить её влияние на время ожидания?
We switched to the new newsletter design five weeks ago. Did it raise the open rate?
Effect of new_design on open_rate? We only have 10 weeks of data, 5 before and 5 after.
Новый дизайн рассылки запустили пять недель назад. Выросла ли открываемость из-за него?
Can you forecast next month's conversion_rate for new visitors?
Forecast California's cigarette sales for the next five years.
Which users are most likely to churn next month? I want a list to target.
Predict the graduation rate for each school next year.
Estimate how much a 30-year-old customer in the north region will spend this year.
Build a model to score which customers will spend the most on the card.
How well can we predict length_of_stay from severity, age and comorbidities?
What revenue should we expect in each store next December?
Give me a model that predicts recoveryDays for a new patient from cholesterol and bmi.
Спрогнозируй конверсию на следующий месяц.
Какие пациенты, скорее всего, будут восстанавливаться дольше всех? Нужен прогноз recovery_days.
Насколько точно можно предсказать длительность госпитализации по остальным колонкам?
We offered the premium card mostly to customers with high credit scores and incomes and low debt. Did the offer increase card spending?
What's the causal effect of premium_card_offer on card_spend? The offer was targeted by our risk model, not random.
Customers who got the premium card offer spend way more. Is that the offer or just who we picked?
Премиальную карту предлагали в основном клиентам с хорошим кредитным рейтингом и высоким доходом. Увеличило ли предложение траты по карте?
Estimate the effect of the premium card offer on spending, adjusting for credit_score, income and debt_ratio.
Did offering the premium card make people spend more? Targeting was based on credit score, income and debt.
Does ICU admission shorten the hospital stay? Doctors admit the sickest, oldest patients with the most comorbidities.
Effect of icu_admission on length_of_stay, controlling for severity_score, age and comorbidities?
Patients sent to intensive care stay longer. Is the ICU making stays longer, or is it who gets sent there?
Сокращает ли перевод в реанимацию срок госпитализации? В реанимацию отправляют самых тяжёлых и пожилых пациентов.
We want the causal effect of ICU care on length of stay from our records. Admission was decided by clinicians based on the patient's condition.
Как icu_admission влияет на length_of_stay с учётом тяжести состояния, возраста и сопутствующих болезней?
